about: X10 decision vectors (ADR-011 §3.3): for each case, the hits judge() gives at each look (signal, value, threshold, in order) and soft() at close (n = 20). Base = [cost_musd, wall_ms, requests, req_bytes, correction 0/1, zspend_musd]. req_ring = [errors, requests]. Regenerate: X10_VECTORS=write cargo test -p kernel-gate extend_sim::tests::rf34_judge_vectors

twin.about: X10 twin vectors (Evaluation plan, the cost test as adopted: exact Wilcoxon signed-rank on per-task log cost ratios, one-sided 'current costlier'). pairs = [current_musd, twin_musd]; r = ln(current) - ln(twin); ranks 1..n by |r| with zeros ranked and counted in n; W+ = the sum of ranks of r > 0; k = the smallest W with P(W+ >= W) <= alpha under the exact null (None: never significant); significant = W+ >= k. No two non-zero pairs tie exactly in max*min.

units.about: X10 unit vectors (sentinel v2 with the adopted fix, Defaults::v2_fix: H8/H10/H11 at ex_j/ex_alpha): turns are [cost_musd, wall_ms, requests, req_bytes, correction 0/1, zspend_musd, unit id]; consecutive turns with the same id form a unit; a unit's value is gm1 = floor((prod(x+1))^(1/n)) - 1 per field (unit values: [cost, wall, req, bytes, zspend]). The ring holds exactly the turns of its newest 40 units (H7's r0 over all of them); the window's units start at its first turn; exceedance K and thresholds use n = the window's unit count at the look, H7 n = the look's turns, H9 the look's requests. hits in judge order (H5b, H8, H10, H11, H7, H9); soft at close over all 20 turns.
